subject: Staged activation & monthly volume schedule for HelmGames pilot
message_1_body:
Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed, HelmGames is planning a closed beta in late June and a public launch in mid-August. Our product/marketing teams have provided a forecast (attached) that shows low usage during beta, then a sharp spike in month 3 at launch, and some seasonality through the holiday quarter.

We wanted to get your guidance on the best way to structure a monthly commit that: 1) keeps our initial commitment small during beta, 2) allows predictable step-ups for the launch month(s) without re-negotiating each time, and 3) protects us from large up-front overcharges if usage overshoots during the first public month.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood support a staged step-up schedule (e.g., base commit for month 1, optional step-up windows in months 2–4)?
- Are there launch-month credits or one-time promotional buffers for first-time customers?
- How are overages invoiced and true-ups handled (monthly, quarterly)?

I've attached our forecast (HelmGames_Monthly_Forecast.xlsx). Happy to jump on a short call to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Alice Yang
Head of Growth, HelmGames
attach: HelmGames_Monthly_Forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)
message_2_subject: Re: Staged activation & monthly volume schedule
message_2_body:
Hi Alice — thanks for the forecast, that helps a lot.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support a staged step-up commit model and provide a launch buffer for the initial public month. Invoice cadence and true-ups are monthly by default, but we can include a simplified true-up mechanism in the SOW to avoid surprise billing.

Suggested structure (high level):
- Month 1 (beta): small base commit (X tokens) at standard committed discount.
- Months 2–4 (onboarding/launch window): two optional step-up windows. Each step-up can be executed by you with 7 days notice; we cap the step-up at +25% for any single window without re-negotiation.
- Launch month promo: one-time 15% launch credit applied to token overages in first public month (month of launch) to buy you time while traffic stabilizes.
- True-up: monthly invoice with a single line-item true-up. We amortize any step-up cost across the remainder of the quarter for predictability if you prefer.

I've attached our current price tier doc for reference (Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_v2.pdf). Laura, can you confirm the discount breakpoints if the customer prefers longer-term smoothing?

If that sounds reasonable, let's lock in a short call early next week and I'll circulate a brief SOW and DocuSign draft.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attach: Redwood_Pricing_Tiers_v2.pdf (PDF)
message_3_subject: Re: Staged activation & monthly volume schedule — discount breakpoints
message_3_body:
Alice / Priyom — quick finance note on breakpoints that keeps your month-to-month flexibility but gives HelmGames predictable unit economics: 

Proposed discount schedule (monthly commit basis):
- 0–2M tokens: standard committed rate (no additional discount)
- 2M–5M tokens: 10% additional volume discount if committed across the month
- 5M+ tokens: 18% additional discount; requires a 3-month minimum at that tier

Step-up mechanics:
- First two step-ups (months 2 and 3) can be executed without changing the contractual tier; step-up cap per window = +25% tokens.
- Any single-month overage > 40% above your last committed monthly amount will be invoiced as overage at the non-committed per-token rate but we can apply the one-time launch credit to soften that.

Operational notes:
- Billing: monthly invoice with a single line for committed usage + an overage/true-up line.
- Reporting: we will share a weekly usage snapshot during the ramp period and daily metrics during week-of-launch if you request.

Ben — want to confirm whether we should offer a one-time onboarding discount to offset integration work (say, $10k credit) as a negotiation lever?

— Laura
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
message_4_subject: Re: Staged activation & monthly volume schedule — procurement questions
message_4_body:
Hi Priyom / Laura,

Thanks for the proposed structure — that maps well to what our product team needs. A couple of procurement-specific items before we proceed: 

1) Launch credit — can Redwood increase the one-time launch credit from 15% to 20% for our first public month if we sign a 6-month commitment for the core tier? That makes the economics easier for our CFO.
2) True-up smoothing — the option to amortize step-up cost across the quarter is appealing. Can you confirm whether amortization will change the effective monthly price during months 2–3 or will it be shown as a separate amortized line-item? We prefer a single blended monthly charge.
3) DocuSign and SOW — can you share a draft SOW and the DocuSign link so our legal can review the T&Cs alongside the numbers?

Raj

message_5_subject: Re: Staged activation & monthly volume schedule — confirmed terms & next steps
message_5_body:
Raj / Alice — appreciate the questions. We can accommodate the 20% launch credit if HelmGames signs a 6-month commitment for the core tier (HLMG-2026-058). Below is the finalable structure for the SOW and DocuSign draft I will circulate: 

Final proposed terms (short):
- Base commit (Month 1 beta): 1.0M tokens at committed rate.
- Step-up windows: Month 2 and Month 3 optional step-ups; each step-up allowed with 7-day notice, cap +25% per window.
- Launch month (first public month): 20% one-time credit applied to token overages for that month if 6-month commitment executed.
- Overages: invoiced monthly at the non-committed rate, but we will present a blended monthly charge if you opt into quarterly amortization; the amortized amount appears as a separate line-item but we can provide a single blended invoice PDF for your accounting team.
- Reporting & ops: weekly ramp snapshot; daily during launch week; dedicated onboarding touchpoint with CS.
- Onboarding credit: Redwood providing a $10k one-time integration credit applied to the first invoice.

Next steps: I will share a concise SOW and DocuSign link by EOD 5/13. If you want the blended monthly view baked into the contract, please confirm and we'll reflect the amortization schedule in Exhibit A.

DocuSign preview: https://app.docusign.com/embedded/ABC-123-HELmgames
Contract link (internal): https://redwood.company/contract/HLMG-2026-058

If that all looks good, Alice — feel free to confirm and we will route to signatures.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
